# Is It AI Generated?

> A free, ad-free detector for AI-written text and AI images. Everything runs in
> the visitor's browser: no upload, no account, no tracking. Ten interface
> languages.

Note on this file: Google Search does not use llms.txt, so it is not a ranking
lever. It is provided for assistants that read it.

## Pages

- [Tool](https://is-it-generated-by-ai.org/): paste text to get an AI index from 0 to 100 with per-sentence
  highlighting and the evidence behind it; drop an image for C2PA provenance and
  pixel forensics.
- [FAQ](https://is-it-generated-by-ai.org/faq/): 55 plain-language questions on reliability, privacy,
  homework, images and C2PA, in ten languages.
- [Legal notice](https://is-it-generated-by-ai.org/legal/): publisher, host, personal data, source code.
- [Statistics](https://is-it-generated-by-ai.org/stats/): anonymous aggregates, and how they are counted.

## How it works, in one paragraph

Text: burstiness computed after filtering headings, paragraph isomorphism,
systematic enumerations, language-specific clichés and hedging verbs, MATTR-50,
Shannon trigram entropy and compression entropy, plus character forensics for
invisible characters and homoglyphs. Images: C2PA Content Credentials, EXIF,
generator signatures, Laplacian noise, chromatic aberration and Benford's law
over the 8x8 DCT.

## Limits, stated plainly

This is a heuristic index, not proof of authorship. It measures style. Short
texts are unreliable, and edited or mixed content misleads any detector. Never
use the score as the only evidence in a decision about a person.
